entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling because I need to return something. I'm just so disappointed it didn't work out.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into this for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF58291. It's about a jersey I bought a little while ago. I was so excited for it.
Okay, I'm pulling up order VF58291 now. I see the VeloFit Pro-Line Jersey. Can you tell me what specifically the issue is with it?
It's the wrong size. I thought I ordered the right one, but it's just way too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping I could exchange it for a larger size, or maybe just get a refund.
I understand. Let me just check the purchase date here... I see it was delivered about 56 days ago. One moment while I review our policy for this item.

Oh, has it been that long? I've just been so busy... I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I really hope we can work something out. I really needed that money back if an exchange isn't possible.

No need to worry. I've confirmed that your jersey falls under our standard 90-day return policy. You are well within the window, so I can absolutely process a full refund for you. Or, if you'd prefer, we can set up an exchange for the correct size.
Really? Oh, that's fantastic news! I was so worried I'd waited too long. Thank you, Isaac! Let's do the exchange, then. I'd love to get the jersey in a size that fits.

Excellent choice. I have initiated the exchange for one size up. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now. Just package the original jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll ship out the new one immediately.
That's perfect. You've been a huge help. I really appreciate it.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that was it. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
